note: How do I... (hub/help.html). Each answer is 2-4 plain steps, where to click, at most one line to copy, and the page where it is done. Facts from the docs named in src, checked against the code 2026-11-18. The lead keeps it current.

items.words: new account buy eval builder 25k 50k rapid add_account bat start page one tap name ninjatrader arm
items.where: At the PC: the LE START icon (Start page), or ADD_ACCOUNT.bat in the bot folder
steps: Buy it at MFFU with the CLUB code. Open NinjaTrader: the new account shows in the Accounts tab.

At the PC open LE START. On the Start page the new account has a card: tap its first button ("Zlarior trades it" for a Builder, "Zlarior + ATLAS" for a Rapid). Or double-click ADD_ACCOUNT.bat, type 1-5 and paste the Name.
It is added NOT armed. When the bot is flat: LE STOP BOT, then LE START > Start trading, and type the live phrase yourself.
items.copy_note: Check (at the PC): one line per account, armed or not, and your MFFU slots.

items.words: passed pass funded upgrade sim name move atlas zlarior start bot target
items.where: MFFU dashboard (Upgrade), then the PC's Start page (LE START)
steps: MFFU dashboard > Stats > the passed eval > Upgrade. One tap, $0, reviewed within 24 h.
The funded account appears in NinjaTrader (Accounts tab) with a NEW Name that contains SIM. Your phone says New MFFU account.
Bot flat: LE STOP BOT. Open LE START and tap "Move ATLAS here (funded)" (or "Move Zlarior here (funded)") on the new account's card. It is added NOT armed.
LE START > Start trading and type the live phrase yourself. From now on the Payout coach tells you when to ask for money.
items.copy_note: The same as the Start page button for ATLAS's 25K (bot stopped). Put the new Name and the first funded day in.

items.words: payout payouts withdraw money cash request when how much 27100 1000 coach tax pot split 80%
items.where: Business > My Accounts > Payout coach card, then the MFFU dashboard
steps: When: ATLAS's funded 25K at $27,100 or more, 2+ traded days this cycle, best day no more than half the cycle's profit. The Payout coach card shows the exact $ for today.
In the MFFU dashboard request $1,000, after the close with no open trade. The bot never asks MFFU for you.
You keep 80% = $800. The day it lands, move 30% ($240) to the tax pot: about $560 is yours.
Tell the PC (line below, your date). The next cycle counts from $26,100.
items.copy_note: At the PC, after MFFU paid. Put the payout day in.

items.q: Pause or flatten ZEUS from my phone
items.words: pause resume flatten kill stop emergency phone safety tailscale private link close position
items.where: Your PC's private Tailscale link + /safety/ (never on this public site)
steps: First time only, at the PC: run the line below. It turns the phone buttons on.
On the phone: Tailscale on, open your PC's private link (the LIVE_LINK.bat address) and add /safety/ at the end. Add it to the Home Screen.
PAUSE = no new trades until the next 4 PM ET; RESUME undoes it. FLATTEN all now and KILL (flatten + stop) need a second tap.
It can never arm a bot or place a trade. Only the PC and your own Tailscale devices can press it.
items.copy_note: Once, at the PC. Off again: the same line with --off.

items.words: restart reboot stop start bot rearm arm phrase flat 17:00 load fixes
items.where: At the PC: the LE STOP BOT icon, then LE START > Start trading
steps: Only when flat: no open trade and no setup waiting (Bots right now shows it).
Best time: 17:00-18:00 ET (the daily break) or after the close. Never with a trade open.
At the PC: LE STOP BOT, then LE START > Start trading (or START_BOT.bat in the bot folder).
When it asks, type I ACCEPT LIVE RISK yourself. It must be running again before Sunday 18:00 ET.
items.copy_note: Check after the start: each account armed or not.

items.words: update upgrade new code version update.bat fix ok red auto update backup
items.where: Nothing (it updates itself); by hand: UPDATE.bat in the bot folder
steps: Nothing to do: the PC updates itself from the backup when it is flat (the 17:02 ET break; a live eval only on Friday or Saturday). Never in trading hours or with a trade open.
To update now (after 16:00 ET, bot flat): double-click UPDATE.bat. LE START also takes the newest code first.
[OK] = fine. [FIX] = that step needs you, and the line says what (for example: a trade is open, run UPDATE after it closes). The old version keeps running.
Still red? Take a photo of the window and send it to Claude.
items.copy_note: Read only: says whether the PC is connected to the backup.

items.words: pc silent offline no report quiet red not reporting ntfy doctor heartbeat
items.where: At the PC: PC_DOCTOR.bat in the bot folder
steps: The ZEUS page shows PC SILENT in red when the PC has not reported.
At the PC double-click PC_DOCTOR.bat. It only looks: nothing is started, stopped, armed or sent.
Read MOST LIKELY CAUSE, then copy the line under NEXT STEP (copy this line) and run it.
Still silent 20 minutes later? Send Claude a photo of the PC_DOCTOR window.
items.copy_note: The same check in the PC's own browser.

items.words: order rejected limit 0 max order quantity scope mnq refused blocked error
steps: "Max order quantity, Limit 0" = MFFU lets this account hold 0 contracts right now. It is not a bot bug.
Between 16:10 and 18:00 ET (and Friday 16:10 to Sunday 18:00) every account is at 0: wait for 18:00 ET.
Still 0 after 18:00 ET: the daily loss limit was hit, or the account failed or passed. Read its status in the MFFU dashboard (Active, Failed, Passed, Pending activation).
Passed? See "My eval passed: what now?". The bot stays off a Limit 0 account by itself.

steps: One list of ideas to make Zlarior (LIT) and ATLAS stronger, re-tested every night on the real backtests with costs in.
Nothing live changes. An idea must pass both 2026 halves, then 4 weeks on paper.
Then you get ONE push: "ZEUS Lab: X passed. Reply yes to adopt". You say yes or no; Claude does the rest.

items.words: taxes tax irs pot 30% set aside quarterly estimated 1040-es self employment
steps: MFFU payouts are self-employment income: nobody takes tax out for you.
The day a payout lands, move 30% to a separate savings account (the tax pot). $800 lands from a $1,000 request: $240 to the pot.
Next federal estimated payment: Jan 15, 2027 (IRS Direct Pay, "estimated tax, 1040-ES").
Keep each payout's date and amount. Education, not tax advice: a tax preparer once a year is usually worth it.

items.words: holiday holidays thanksgiving christmas new year early close halt closed mlk
items.where: Nothing to do: the bot handles it. See the Risk calendar.
steps: The bot stops new trades 15 min before each early close and is flat 5 min before it.
Thu Nov 26 halt 13:00 ET; Fri Nov 27 and Thu Dec 24 close 13:15 ET; Dec 25 and Jan 1 closed; Mon Jan 18 halt 13:00 ET.
Never trade by hand after the bot's last entry on those days. MFFU does not flatten you: open at the halt = the account fails.
Holiday weeks and the 7-day rule: if the phone warns, place 1 MNQ in and out by hand before 12:59 ET.
items.copy_note: At the PC: the next closures and early closes.

steps: Prices with the CLUB code at checkout: Builder 25K $63, Builder 50K $91.80, Rapid EOD 25K $97.20, Rapid EOD 50K $165.
Budget rule: at most $150 from your own pocket for new evals. After that a new account is paid from a payout (after the 30% tax pot).
MFFU limits: 10 evals, 5 funded. Goals shows which one is next and when.
Then add it: see "Add a new MFFU account".

items.q: Move the phone site to Cloudflare (no badge)
items.words: cloudflare hosting netlify badge site host pages free move dashboard cloudflare_setup bat token account id
items.where: dash.cloudflare.com (the key), then CLOUDFLARE_SETUP.bat in the bot folder on the PC
steps: dash.cloudflare.com (free) > your picture > Profile > API Tokens > Create Token > Custom token > Account / Cloudflare Pages / Edit > Create. Copy the key and your Account ID (Workers & Pages page).
At the PC: Double-click CLOUDFLARE_SETUP.bat. Paste the key (you only see *) and the Account ID. It installs Node.js, saves both in Windows and publishes once.
It shows the address, normally https://olympus-dash.pages.dev: add it to your Home Screen. A problem shows one [FIX] line. Never paste the key in a chat.
items.copy_note: At the PC, in the bot folder: double-click it (no typing).

items.words: mffu address verification verify check bank statement pdf kyc identity upload
steps: Why: so the funded 25K's first payout (about late December) is not blocked.
Download a recent bank statement as a PDF from your bank's app or website. Your name and home address must be on it.
MFFU dashboard > the address verification request > upload the PDF. Wait for MFFU's email that it is approved.
Never send the statement to Claude or put it in the bot folder: it stays between you and MFFU.
